items.title: PPL (PPL) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Weigh Growth Against Policy Risks
items.summary: PPL's Fair Value price target has shifted from US$41.20 to US$40.33, a reduction of about 2.1% that may catch the eye of investors tracking valuation updates. This move sits against mixed analyst commentary, with some research pointing to upside tied to regulated growth and large load themes, while others focus on policy and demand risks that can cap how high targets go.
